# Meta Social Technologies MCP (Official) - Integration Guide

## Overview

Meta's remote MCP server for developers building on the Meta Social Technologies Developer Platform (developers.facebook.com). Formerly known as the Meta Developer Tools MCP. It manages the apps and integrations you build: configure webhooks, check compliance, review app status, monitor API health, and search Meta's developer documentation.

## What it can do

- Configure and inspect webhooks
- Check compliance status for your apps
- Review app status and settings
- Monitor API health
- Search developer documentation

## Who it is for

Developers and platform teams building on Meta APIs (Facebook Login, Instagram, WhatsApp Business, Marketing API, and the rest of the developers.facebook.com platform). It is a developer-operations server rather than an end-user data server.

## Connecting

Remote MCP server; see Meta's documentation page for the endpoint and per-client setup snippets.
